title: ha: automation for multi-AZ HA & DR runbooks (Helm + Terraform + installer)
author: Miguel Alvarez
description:
Motivation: make HA and DR runbooks executable and testable as code for Private deployments. This PR adds automation wiring across the private-installer, the Helm charts, and terraform modules to support multi-AZ failover drills, automated restore workflows, and runbooks-as-code for operator-driven drills. Goals: 1) Provide terraform modules and example stacks to provision multi-AZ test clusters for restore drills; 2) Extend the private-installer to expose DR hooks (snapshot export/import, manifest toggles) and upgrade/rollback helpers; 3) Add Helm chart hooks and a new 'drill' job to run controlled failovers and validate KV/cache warmup; 4) Supply runnable runbooks (markdown + scripts) that can be executed by SREs and customers; 5) Add CI smoke tests that run a lightweight restore drill in CI to avoid regressions.

Changes in this PR include: terraform/modules/ha (new): multi_az_cluster module, dr_snapshot_bucket module; private-installer: dr hooks (snapshot-export, snapshot-import), upgrade-rollback helpers, new CLI flag --dr-mode; helm/redwood (chart updates): post-install Job template redwood-drill-job, additional readiness/liveness probe tuning for multi-AZ; runbooks/as-code: md + bash helpers to orchestrate drill steps; ci: new pipeline job pipeline/drill-smoke that spins up small cluster and runs basic restore. Testing: local e2e on GCP and AWS; CI smoke passes in GitHub Actions; staging dry-run with customer config (redwood-corp) completed.
commit_summary: Add terraform multi_az_cluster and dr_snapshot_bucket modules
Expose DR hooks and CLI flag in private-installer (snapshot export/import, --dr-mode)
Helm chart: add redwood-drill-job, probe adjustments, optional init containers for kv-warmup
Add CI job pipeline/drill-smoke and basic IAM policy templates for test runs
Fix: idempotency in snapshot import path and retries for snapshot copy

Miguel Alvarez: Updated terraform module to include least-privilege IAM roles and documented them in examples (reply)
Evan Turner: The Helm job could interfere with autoscaler in Dedicated. Suggest adding a toleration and nodeSelector to the job. (requested changes)
Miguel Alvarez: Added tolerations/nodeSelector in values and document recommended settings for Dedicated pools (reply)
Louise Chen: CI smoke looks flakey on first run due to timing of kv-warmup, add retry/backoff and increase readiness timeout. (comment)
Miguel Alvarez: Increased probe timeouts and added retry loop in drill-runner.sh (reply)

release_notes:
- Add automation for HA/DR restore drills: terraform modules, installer hooks, Helm drill job, and runbooks-as-code.
- Backwards-compatible: default behavior unchanged, DR features behind flags (e.g., --dr-mode, values.dr.enabled).
- Operators: see docs/operational/ha-dr-runbooks.md for steps and required IAM roles.
notes_for_ops: Runbooks-as-code located under runbooks/drills include scripts for snapshot export/import and validation. Use examples/terraform/multi-az-example to provision a test cluster. In production, enable dr features with caution and test in staging before running on customer clusters.
